headlines.title: NASA Selects Blue Origin as Mars Telecommunications Network Provider
headlines.summary: NASA awarded Blue Origin a contract Tuesday to develop the agency’s Mars Telecommunications Network, a next-generation communications system that will enable reliable, high-bandwidth communications and navigation service
